name: Sorrow Hill
summary: At Sorrow Hill, the dead rise beneath headstones south of Andorhal. Plague cauldrons have corrupted the old burial ground, and its dead roam again.

sections.title: A Burden of Graves
sections.body:
Before the Third War, Sorrow Hill received the dead of Andorhal and the nearby townships. When the Scourge brought the Plague of Undeath, the gravediggers could not keep pace. Shallow, poorly marked pits spread around the cemetery’s neat crypts.

Terrified survivors abandoned the old rites and burned their loved ones on a great pyre to the south. They feared the dead would rise. Before Andorhal fell completely, those who remained entombed Lord Uther the Lightbringer on the hill’s high ground. His burial gave the hill its sorrowful name.

sections.title: The Resurrected Dead
sections.body:
Plague cauldrons across the region have corrupted Sorrow Hill. Soldiers and citizens buried here now roam among the headstones as skeletal flayers and ravenous ghouls. Skeletal mages and a Scourge commander hold the crypts in the southeast.

The cemetery lies on the road between Chillwind Camp and Andorhal. The Alliance and the Argent Dawn send patrols to cut down the undead and hold their foothold in the region.

faq.q: Why was this graveyard named Sorrow Hill?
aliases: why is it called sorrow hill
faq.answer: Andorhal’s surviving people gave Sorrow Hill its name when they buried Lord Uther the Lightbringer on its high ground. As they fled the Scourge, laying their fallen champion in a grand tomb was their final act together.

faq.q: Why are there so many shallow graves here?
faq.answer: The Plague of Undeath killed people in Andorhal faster than they could build proper tombs. Citizens dug hasty, poorly marked graves, then turned to mass burning when the onslaught overwhelmed them.

faq.q: Who is buried in Sorrow Hill?
faq.answer: Thousands of fallen soldiers and citizens of Andorhal lie at Sorrow Hill, along with Lord Uther the Lightbringer in his great tomb. The cemetery also holds cannoneer Dargal’s resting place and a monument to Joseph Redpath, whose body was destroyed.

faq.q: What threat does Sorrow Hill pose today?
faq.answer: The Lich King’s plague cauldrons corrupted Sorrow Hill, and its dead rose as skeletal flayers, ravenous ghouls and skeletal mages. A Scourge commander leads them from the southeastern crypts, threatening the southern approach to Andorhal.

angles.text: As a paladin, you find mourning and reverence at Sorrow Hill. Visit Uther’s Tomb and drive back the undead defiling the grounds around your mentor.
Just down the road from Chillwind Camp, Sorrow Hill guards the way to Andorhal. It is also the sacred resting place of Lordaeron’s fallen defenders.
